items.question: Who's designing our next advertisement?
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“Who's designing our next advertisement?”，自然应答是“Check the meeting minutes.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：A（Check the meeting minutes.）。
